title: Moon 0.4.0 beta
notes:
[Download Moon for Mac](https://github.com/madetonight/moon-browser/releases/download/v0.4.0-beta/Moon-0.4.0-arm64.dmg)

One installer for Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later. Open the DMG and drag Moon to Applications. The same DMG powers signed in-app updates.

- Customize background, foreground, text and an optional accent in Settings → Appearance → Colors, with separate light and dark palettes.
- Sidebar tabs always show page titles, with smoother hover feedback.
- Pearl Current app icon. Installed app size approximately 11 MB; download approximately 5 MB.

This beta is Apple Development signed and is not Apple-notarized. Connected installations can use Settings → About → Check now. The signed update feed is maintained in the repository. GitHub’s automatic source-code links contain source, not additional app installers.
